question: What syllabic recitation must be added at the end of all mantras?
premises: The position is the end of all mantras
The syllable ta is recited twice
inference: After meditating thus, one should recite the syllable ta twice at the end of all mantras
uncertainties: ṭa treated as mantra syllable, not translated
plain_english: Having meditated thus, one should recite the syllable ṭa twice at the end of all mantras.
